title: Observability: provider callback failures logged only in write/finalize, not set_iv/sign/verify/agree/reset
description: ops->set_iv(), ops->set_aad(), ops->get_tag(), ops->set_tag(), ops->sign(), ops->verify(), ops->agree(), and ops->sess_reset() all return their raw error code directly to the ioctl caller with no pr_err/pr_debug log. A support engineer cannot determine which algo/provider/wolfCrypt error caused a silent -EINVAL or -EIO without adding printks and reproducing the failure. Contrast: ops->update() and ops->finalize() correctly log algo, provider, and ret. The same pattern must be applied to all provider callback failure paths.
close_reason: fixed: pr_err_ratelimited added on callback failure in ioctl_set_iv, ioctl_do_sign, ioctl_do_verify, ioctl_do_agree, ioctl_reset
